name: taskflow
description: A full-stack task management application and engineering learning project

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --workspace @taskflow/api" "npm run dev --workspace @taskflow/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @taskflow/api && npm run build --workspace @taskflow/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @taskflow/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @taskflow/web
